杨瑞察觉到了众人的异样，却没有丝毫在意，依旧笑容温和，主动与众人闲聊，话题大多围绕着古镇的风土人情、山水景色，言语间满是对这座古镇的喜爱，没有丝毫提及任何敏感的话题，也没有打探众人的底细，显得坦荡而从容。

胡九郎放下茶杯，眼神平静地看着杨瑞，轻声说道：

“杨镇长，我们看到街上有很多人，他们似乎都很崇拜您，您能将这座古镇治理得如此井井有条，真是厉害。”

他刻意夸赞杨瑞，想要放松他的警惕，再寻找试探的机会。

杨瑞笑了笑，语气谦逊地说道：

“过奖了，我只是做了我该做的事情。这座古镇，之所以能如此安宁，不是我一个人的功劳，是所有在这里生活的人共同努力的结果。我只是尽我所能，为大家创造一个安稳、平和的生活环境而已。”

他的话语谦逊而真诚，眼神中没有丝毫骄傲与自负，仿佛真的只是一个一心为民的镇长。

可越是这样，众人心中的疑惑就越甚，一个普通的凡人，怎么可能治理好一座藏着众多异能者的秘境古镇？怎么可能让这些桀骜不驯的异能者，如此心甘情愿地服从他的管理？

杨树远端起茶杯，轻轻抿了一口，语气平淡地说道：

“杨镇长年纪轻轻，就有如此胸襟和能力，真是难得。只是不知杨镇长在这里生活了多久？这座古镇又存在了多久？”

杨瑞闻言，眼中闪过一丝淡淡的追忆，语气温和地说道：

“我在这里生活了很多年了，从小就生长在这里。这座古镇，已经存在了上百年，一直与世隔绝，很少有外人前来，直到近几年，才有一些人偶然误入这里，自愿留下来定居。”

“上百年？”

众人心中一惊，这座古镇竟然已经存在了上百年，而且一直与世隔绝，这实在是太过诡异。

胡九郎眼中闪过一丝警惕，轻声问道：

“杨镇长看起来十分年轻，没想到竟然已经在这里生活了这么多年，真是让人敬佩。只是不知，杨镇长今年高寿？”

杨瑞笑了笑，语气从容地说道：

“我今年二十有六，高寿说笑了。”

冷欣终于忍不住开口道：

“杨镇长，我想问你一个问题。你有没有见过一个叫陆明的人？他也是一个异能者，不久前失踪了，我怀疑他也在这里。”

她没有多余的试探，直接开门见山，想要从杨瑞的反应中，找到陆明的踪迹。

听到“陆明”两个字，杨瑞的眼中闪过一丝极淡的异样，快得让人几乎无法察觉，随即又恢复了平静，语气温和地说道：

“姑娘所说的陆明，我倒是没有印象。我们古镇里的人我都认识，并没有叫陆明的人。或许他并没有误入我们这个秘境吧。”

冷欣紧紧盯着杨瑞的眼睛，想要从他的眼神中找到一丝破绽，可杨瑞的眼神清澈而平静，没有丝毫慌乱，也没有丝毫隐瞒，仿佛真的没有见过陆明。

冷欣心中的失落更甚，却又不肯放弃，她总觉得杨瑞在撒谎，陆明一定在这里，只是被他藏了起来。

Yang Rui noticed everyone's strangeness, but didn't care at all. He still smiled gently and took the initiative to chat with everyone. Most of the topics revolved around the customs and scenery of the ancient town. His words were full of love for this ancient town. He did not mention any sensitive topics, nor did he inquire about anyone's details. He seemed magnanimous and calm.

Hu Jiulang put down his teacup, looked at Yang Rui calmly, and said softly:

"Mayor Yang, we see a lot of people on the street, and they all seem to admire you. It's amazing that you can manage this ancient town in such an orderly manner."

He deliberately praised Yang Rui, wanting to relax his vigilance and look for opportunities to test him.

Yang Rui smiled and said in a humble tone:

"Thank you, I just did what I should do. The reason why this ancient town is so peaceful is not my fault alone, it is the result of the joint efforts of all the people living here. I just tried my best to create a stable and peaceful living environment for everyone."

His words were humble and sincere, and there was no pride or conceit in his eyes, as if he was really just a mayor who was dedicated to the people.

But the more this happens, the more doubtful everyone becomes. How can an ordinary mortal manage a secret ancient town that hides many superpowers?How could it be possible for these rebellious superpowers to obey his management so willingly?

Yang Shuyuan picked up the teacup, took a sip, and said in a calm tone:

"It's really rare for Mayor Yang to have such broad-mindedness and ability at such a young age. I just don't know how long Mayor Yang has lived here? How long has this ancient town existed?"

When Yang Rui heard this, a faint trace of recollection flashed in his eyes, and he said in a gentle tone:

"I have lived here for many years and grew up here since I was a child. This ancient town has existed for hundreds of years and has always been isolated from the world. Very few outsiders come. It was only in recent years that some people accidentally wandered here and voluntarily stayed and settled."

"Hundreds of years?"

Everyone was shocked. This ancient town has existed for hundreds of years and has been isolated from the world. This is really weird.

A trace of vigilance flashed in Hu Jiulang's eyes, and he asked softly:

"Mayor Yang looks very young. I didn't expect that he has lived here for so many years. It's really admirable. I just don't know, will Mayor Yang live a long life this year?"

Yang Rui smiled and said calmly:

"I am twenty-six this year, Gao Shou is joking."

Leng Xin finally couldn't help but said:

"Mayor Yang, I want to ask you a question. Have you ever seen a man named Lu Ming? He is also a superpower and disappeared not long ago. I suspect he is here too."

She went straight to the point without any extra testing, hoping to find traces of Lu Ming from Yang Rui's reaction.

Hearing the word "Lu Ming", Yang Rui's eyes flashed with a trace of something strange, so fast that it was almost undetectable. Then he regained his composure and said in a gentle tone:

"I have no impression of what the girl said about Lu Ming. I know everyone in our ancient town, and there is no one named Lu Ming. Maybe he did not stray into our secret realm."

Leng Xin stared closely at Yang Rui's eyes, trying to find any flaw in his eyes, but Yang Rui's eyes were clear and calm, without any panic or concealment, as if he had never seen Lu Ming before.

Leng Xin felt even more disappointed, but she refused to give up. She always felt that Yang Rui was lying. Lu Ming must be here, but he was hiding him.
